units.source_text: “木头会腐烂，沾在一起的沙子也会腐烂哇。

en.t: Wood rots, and sand that has stuck together rots too, you know.

units.source_text: ……被沙子埋没的房子，挖开天花板瞅一瞅，那里会出现相当肥沃的泥土，连黄瓜也种得出来……”

en.t: ...If you dig open the ceiling of a house buried in sand and take a look, fairly fertile soil will appear there, and you can even grow cucumbers...
